social_condition: Small fleet, small customer set, static routing, limited constraints
required_quantum_evidence: problem formulation; QAOA/QUBO/Ising definition; benchmark metric definition
feasibility_workflow_warning: No operational workflow claim is made.
notes: Toy-scale relevance only; not evidence for operational logistics.

social_condition: Urban last-mile or commercial routing with capacity, time windows, depot constraints, and service constraints
required_quantum_evidence: reported qubits; reported p/layers/theoretical depth; feasible or valid route evidence if reported
width_depth_evidence: reported qubits; QAOA p; theoretical depth; feasibility rate if available
feasibility_workflow_warning: Feasible routes matter more than low objective values on invalid bitstrings.
notes: Use for constrained urban routing, but not for deployment readiness.

social_condition: EV fleet operation where SOC, charging station choice, charging time, depot charging, or grid/depot capacity affect routing
required_quantum_evidence: hardware or hardware-aware qubits; transpiled gates; shots; runtime; feasible-solution behavior
width_depth_evidence: hardware width; transpiled gates; shots; runtime; p versus physical depth
feasibility_workflow_warning: EV constraints may increase encoding and feasibility burdens before operational scale is reached.
main_sources: iea-ev-charging-2026; nrel-mdhd-charging-2024; evrptw-2014-schneider; vrp-2025-azfar-arxiv; nisq-2018-preskill; vqa-2021-cerezo
notes: EV stock is background context, not a direct Resource readiness value or VRP K.

social_condition: Large-scale or dynamic EV logistics with changing demand, traffic, charging congestion, and frequent reoptimization
required_quantum_evidence: logical/physical qubits; theoretical depth; gate budget; runtime/workflow assumptions; feasibility assumptions
width_depth_evidence: logical/physical qubits; theoretical depth; gate budget; optimizer/runtime assumptions
feasibility_workflow_warning: Dynamic reoptimization makes runtime and hybrid-loop burden central, not just circuit width.
notes: Width/depth are evidence for conditional feasibility or impracticality, not proof of near-term usefulness.

social_condition: TMS/dispatch workflow, data availability, constraints, classical baselines, and deployment KPIs are ready for deployment-grade optimization
required_quantum_evidence: application-level utility evidence; classical baseline comparison; FTQC/full-stack resource assumptions; operational workflow evidence
width_depth_evidence: fault-tolerant resources; logical qubits; gate budget; error correction; end-to-end workflow
feasibility_workflow_warning: Do not claim quantum advantage without application-specific primary utility evidence and classical baseline comparison.
notes: QRL5 can be defined from quantum/readiness sources, but SRL5 social workflow evidence still needs primary TMS/fleet-operation sources.
